PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Only one square fits both parts of Erin's clue ("She was sitting in a chair. She was in a corner of her area."). So Erin (E) must be at row 2, column 3. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Clement's clue ("Someone else in his area was beside a basket.") needs the person beside a basket in Clement's area on a square that does not share his row or column; that rules out squares for Clement. All of Alma's squares are in column 5, so nobody else can use it. Clement's own clue ("Someone else in his area was beside a basket.") rules out more squares. Using the general clue ("There were exactly two people sitting in a chair."), some squares are ruled out for Clement. So Clement (C) must be at row 6, column 7. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: Look at Daisy: every square she could still use shares a row or column with row 5, column 1. So nobody else can stand at row 5, column 1, or Daisy would have nowhere to go. The murderer must be in Vera's area without sharing her row or column; that rules out squares for Vera. Only one square of column 2 is still open to anyone (row 5, column 2). Someone must stand there, so nobody else can use row 5. So Alma (A) must be at row 7, column 5. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Daisy that fits her clue ("She was in the Warehouse or the Dock."). So Daisy (D) must be at row 5, column 2. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: Who can be the person beside a basket in Clement's area? Only Bruno, because nobody else can still reach a square that fits Clement's clue ("Someone else in his area was beside a basket."). That rules out Bruno's other squares. So Bruno (B) must be at row 4, column 6. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Vera. So Vera (the victim) must be at row 1, column 1. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Flora that fits her clue ("She was east of Vera."). So Flora (F) must be at row 3, column 4. Cross out her row and column. Flora is the only person in the Cave with Vera, so Flora is the murderer!
